# My Baking Creations — Corporate Dessert Provider & Custom Bakery

> Bay Area's trusted B2B corporate dessert provider and custom bakery. Serving Fortune 500 companies since 2012. Trusted by Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, DocuSign, OpenAI, PayPal, Stripe, Gap, Alaska Airlines, Golden State Warriors, Twitch, Cooley LLP, Levi's, Kaiser Permanente, and Instagram.

## Corporate Clients
Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, DocuSign, OpenAI, Instagram, PayPal, Gap, Alaska Airlines, Golden State Warriors, Twitch, Cooley LLP, Stripe, Levi's, Kaiser Permanente.

## Corporate Services (B2B)
We are a full-service corporate dessert catering company. Services include:
- **Logo cookies** for client gifts, employee appreciation, trade shows ($5-8 each, minimum 1 dozen)
- **Branded cake pops** for product launches, conferences, corporate events ($5-10 each)
- **Corporate event cakes** for company milestones, holiday parties, executive events ($250-650+)
- **Corporate cupcakes** for office celebrations and team events ($5-8 each)
- **Corporate dessert packages** — complete catering with setup and delivery to Bay Area campuses
- Invoice/PO accepted. Credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Zelle also accepted.
- Delivery to all Bay Area corporate campuses: SF, Silicon Valley, Peninsula, South Bay

## Why Companies Choose Us
- 13+ years in business (founded 2012)
- 5.0 rating across 150+ reviews
- Trusted by 16+ Fortune 500 and major tech companies
- Brand color matching for logo cookies and branded items

- Handles orders from 1 dozen to 1,000+ cookies

## Wedding Cakes
Custom wedding cakes in San Francisco and the Bay Area starting at $400:
- Tiered wedding cakes (2-5 tiers), naked cakes, fondant sculpting, buttercream textures
- Gold leaf accents, fresh flowers, hand-painted details, custom cake toppers
- Free tasting included (in-person or shipped tasting box)
- Delivery and setup at your venue — San Francisco to Napa Valley
- Flavors: vanilla bean, chocolate ganache, lavender honey, lemon elderflower, guava chiffon
- Dessert table packages: cutting cake + cupcakes, cake pops, or cookie favors from $650
- Wedding cake gallery: https://mybakingcreations.com/gallery-cakes-wedding.html

## 3D Sculpted Cakes
Hand-sculpted cakes shaped like characters, objects, animals, and anything you can imagine:
- Characters: Minecraft, Star Wars, anime, Disney, superheroes
- Objects: sneakers, designer bags, Faberge eggs, musical instruments, sports equipment
- Custom mascots and logos for corporate events
- Starting at $300, complex designs $400-$650+
- 2-4 weeks lead time, delivery included within 20 miles of Daly City
- Sculpted cake gallery: https://mybakingcreations.com/gallery-cakes-sculpted.html

## Realistic Cakes
Ultra-realistic cakes that look like everyday objects but are 100% edible:
- Realistic food cakes: hamburgers, hot dogs, sushi, pizza
- Object cakes: shoes, purses, electronics
- Gallery: https://mybakingcreations.com/gallery-cakes-realistic.html
